General_Subtitle: Windows 11 DDC/CI Hardware Monitor Brightness Control
Desc_ResetDefaults: Restore all settings to their default values
Confirm_ResetDefaults: All settings will be reset. Do you want to continue?
Tip_ResetDefaults: Reset all settings to default values
Status_Ready_Msg: DDC/CI communication active. Hardware monitor brightness will update directly.
Status_Offline_Msg: No DDC/CI compatible monitor answered, or driver is still initializing.
Status_Summary_Ready: DDC/CI driver active. Hardware brightness control enabled.
Status_Summary_Offline: DDC/CI communication unavailable. Using fallback state.
Desc_AppTheme: Visual appearance of the settings window
Desc_TransparencyEffects: Enable Mica and Acrylic backdrop transparency across all app windows
Desc_Language: Select application display language. If the Windows language is unsupported, English (United States) is used.
Desc_StartWithWindows: Launch ClickBrightness automatically on system logon
Desc_StartWithWindows_NotInstalled: Launch ClickBrightness automatically on system logon (Available when installed in Program Files)
Desc_MonitorsToControl: Select which monitors have their brightness adjusted
Desc_HotkeyAdjust: Enable global keyboard shortcuts to raise and lower brightness
Desc_KeyUp: Global shortcut to raise hardware brightness
Desc_KeyDown: Global shortcut to lower hardware brightness
Desc_HotkeyAdjustShowOsd: Display the on-screen brightness banner when pressing stepping hotkeys
Desc_HotkeyPresets: Enable global keyboard shortcuts to jump to brightness presets
Desc_KeyPreset1: Global shortcut to set brightness to Preset 1
Desc_Preset1Brightness: Target brightness level applied by the Preset 1 shortcut
Desc_KeyPreset2: Global shortcut to set brightness to Preset 2
Desc_Preset2Brightness: Target brightness level applied by the Preset 2 shortcut
Desc_HotkeyPresetsShowOsd: Display the on-screen brightness banner when switching presets
Desc_HotkeyPresetToggle: Toggle between two brightness presets using a single shortcut
Desc_KeyPresetToggle: Press shortcut to toggle between Preset 1 and Preset 2
Desc_PresetToggle1Brightness: First target brightness level toggled by the shortcut
Desc_PresetToggle2Brightness: Second target brightness level toggled by the shortcut
Desc_HotkeyPresetToggleShowOsd: Display the on-screen brightness banner when toggling presets
Desc_ResetShortcuts: Restore hotkeys to defaults (F14, F13, F15, F16, F17)
Desc_DelayEnabled: Debounce rapid key presses before hardware adjustments
Desc_WaitTime: Hardware debounce delay before updating monitor
Desc_HoldSpeed: Key hold interval for smooth stepping (higher = slower)
Desc_OverlayTheme: Visual appearance and color theme of the brightness overlay banner
Desc_OverlayTimeout: Duration the brightness overlay stays visible after adjustments
Desc_OverlayUseWindowsAccent: Match the on-screen display indicator bar to Windows accent
Desc_OverlayCustomAccent: Fill color for OSD indicator bar (configured when Windows accent is off)
Desc_TrayShowPercentage: Choose how the brightness percentage is displayed on the system tray icon
Desc_TrayIconColor: Custom color for the system tray percentage text
Desc_TrayIconDualColor: Use a different percentage icon color when Windows is in dark mode
Desc_TrayIconColorDark: Custom color for the system tray percentage text in dark mode
Desc_TrayFont: Font family used to render the taskbar tray brightness number
Desc_TrayFontWeight: Stroke thickness from 100 to 900 (e.g. 300 Light, 350 Semilight, 400 Regular)
Desc_TrayWheel: Adjust brightness by scrolling the mouse wheel directly over the notification tray icon
Desc_TrayWheelStep: Percentage adjustment per mouse wheel notch
Desc_TrayWheelShowOsd: Display the on-screen brightness banner while scrolling over the tray icon
Desc_TrayWheelDelay: Debounce rapid mouse wheel scrolling before updating monitor hardware
Desc_TrayWheelWaitTime: Delay in milliseconds before sending hardware brightness commands to the display
Desc_TrayMiddleClick: Set a specific brightness level when clicking the middle mouse button on the tray icon
Desc_TrayMiddleClickShowOsd: Display the on-screen brightness banner when middle-clicking the tray icon
Desc_TrayMiddleClickBrightness: Brightness percentage applied when middle-clicking the tray icon
Desc_FlyoutScrollEnabled: Adjust brightness by scrolling the mouse wheel over the flyout slider
Desc_FlyoutScrollStep: Percentage adjustment per mouse wheel notch on the flyout slider
Desc_FlyoutKeyboardEnabled: Adjust brightness using keyboard arrow keys, Page Up/Down, and Home/End
Desc_FlyoutScrollDelay: Debounce rapid mouse wheel scrolling before hardware adjustments
Desc_FlyoutScrollWaitTime: Hardware debounce delay after scrolling before updating monitor
Desc_FlyoutButtonDelay: Debounce rapid preset button clicks before hardware adjustments
Desc_FlyoutButtonWaitTime: Hardware debounce delay after clicking buttons before updating monitor
Desc_FlyoutUseWindowsAccent: Apply system accent color to the flyout slider filled track
Desc_FlyoutCustomAccent: Fill color for flyout slider track (configured when Windows accent is off)
Shortcuts_Subtitle: Global hotkeys for brightness stepping and preset jumping
OSD_Subtitle: Visual overlay popup for real-time brightness adjustments
Tray_Subtitle: Taskbar indicator, live percentage typography, and mouse actions
FlyoutSlider_Subtitle: Hardware brightness slider popup with mouse wheel control
About_Subtitle: Lightweight, modern Windows 11 DDC/CI monitor brightness utility
About_AppType: Native WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK 2.6 Desktop Application
About_Description: A modern, lightweight Windows 11 utility for controlling hardware monitor brightness via DDC/CI (VCP code 0x10). Supports on-screen display (OSD), system tray live indicator with mouse wheel stepping, and a smooth flyout slider.
About_License: Free and Open Source under the MIT License.
